def: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a stringed instrument; by extension, a poem set to music; specifically, an epigram

words.word: and now am i their song
against me and i was the song
me therefore we will sing my songs

occurrences.text: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
words: And now am I their song

occurrences.text: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
words: against me and I was the song

occurrences.text: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
The Lord was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the Lord.
words: me therefore we will sing my songs

occurrences.text: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
